About the Tidewater Gazette

The Tidewater Gazette is published by Tidewater Media Co-operative Limited, a reader-owned co-operative founded in Halifax in 2016 after the last daily on the South Shore closed. It is funded by 4,100 subscribers and carries no advertising.

Masthead

  • Aisha Doucette, editor-in-chief
  • Marcus Bell, business editor
  • Priya Nair, managing director of the co-operative

Editorial standards

We publish corrections at the top of the corrected story and name our sources wherever we can. Members of the co-operative elect the board; the board does not direct coverage.
